applicant_utility.summary: There is nothing to apply for here: UQ assesses you automatically when you apply to study, so your real decision point is the UQ program application itself, not a separate scholarship form. The 25% reduction is applied before each semester's tuition due date and runs for the whole program, which makes it a meaningful multi-year saving rather than a one-off first-semester gesture. Selection is relative, not absolute - UQ ranks you against other offer holders in your commencement semester - so a strong result in an oversubscribed intake matters more than the same result in a quiet one. The exclusion rule is strict: if you already hold another UQ scholarship, fee reduction or rebate (the UQ English Language Scholarship is the only exception) you are out, and a full external sponsorship also disqualifies you, though a partial one does not.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants to a full-time UQ coursework program in 2027 who are not already holding another U scholarship, UQ fee reduction or a full external sponsorship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target program is on the eligible programs list in the current terms and conditions PDF
Make sure you are applying full-time and for a 2027 commencement, since both are hard conditions
Clear every condition on your offer promptly, because the scholarship notification only arrives with the unconditional offer or once conditions are met
Check you are not holding another UQ scholarship, tuition fee reduction or rebate before relying on this one
Watch for the acceptance deadline in your offer letter and accept by the date UQ specifies
Keep your enrolment full-time in the semester named in the offer, since the reduction is tied to that program and semester
common_rejection_risks: Holding another UQ scholarship, fee reduction or rebate, which excludes you outright (only the UQ English Language Scholarship is exempt)
Holding a full external scholarship or sponsorship, which also excludes you
Not satisfying all conditions of a conditional offer, so no scholarship notification is ever triggered
Assuming a partial external sponsorship disqualifies you when it does not, and dropping the sponsorship unnecessarily
Missing the offer acceptance deadline that UQ sends after the award is made
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 75% of tuition fees each semester, plus all living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, flights and visa costs.
document_audit: There is no scholarship form, so the documents that matter are the ones in your UQ program application - entry rank evidence and English proficiency evidence
The eligible programs list is only in the terms and conditions PDF, not on the scholarship page, so download and check it rather than assuming all programs qualify
Two sets of terms and conditions are published (2027 and 2026) - make sure you are reading the one for your commencement year
alerts: Assessment is competitive within your commencement semester, so the same profile can succeed in one intake and miss out in another
UQ fixes the number of awards only loosely - it 'may vary' - so there is no guaranteed quota
The reduction is valid only for the program and commencement semester named in the offer letter
If you are a partial external scholarship holder you remain eligible, but a full one does not
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit your full-time UQ program application for 2027, satisfy all offer conditions, and wait for the scholarship notification to arrive with your unconditional offer or once conditions are met.
